ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Defender Threat Severity Default Action Set to 'Allow' or 'NoAction'
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of PowerShell to execute the 'Set-MpPreference' cmdlet to configure Windows Defender's threat severity default action to 'Allow' (value '6') or 'NoAction' (value '9').
This is a highly suspicious configuration change that effectively disables Defender's ability to automatically mitigate threats of a certain severity level.
An attacker might use this technique via the command line to bypass defenses before executing payloads.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*Set\\-MpPreference.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-LowThreatDefaultAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ModerateThreatDefaultAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-HighThreatDefaultAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-SevereThreatDefaultAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ltdefac\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-mtdefac\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-htdefac\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-stdefac\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Allow.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*6.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*NoAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*9.*")))
